**Setup.** Let the unknown side be x, with the other sides 68 and 60, and area 960 cm².

Take the side of length 60 as the base. The height to it is h = 2·960/60 = 32 cm.

The 68 cm side, the height and the base line form a right triangle, so the foot of the height lies at distance √(68² − 32²) = √(4624 − 1024) = √3600 = 60 cm from the end of the base shared with the 68 cm side.

The base has length 60, so the foot is either at the other end of the base or 60 cm beyond it. That gives two cases:

1. The foot coincides with the other end of the base. The triangle is right-angled at that end, and x = h = 32 cm. Check: 32² + 60² = 1024 + 3600 = 4624 = 68², and the area is ½·32·60 = 960. ✓.
2. The foot lies 60 cm beyond the other end of the base, so that end is 120 cm from the foot. Then x = √(120² + 32²) = √15424 = 8√241 ≈ 124.2 cm. The area is ½·60·32 = 960, so this triangle also satisfies the conditions.

The problem as stated allows both values. The intended answer is the right triangle with sides 32, 60, 68.

Final answer: 32 cm (the other valid, obtuse configuration gives 8√241 ≈ 124.2 cm)
